question: What preparatory recitation must precede the performance of the rite?
premises: The gāyatrī is to be chanted
It must be chanted one hundred and eight times
The rite is performed after this chanting
inference: One should chant the gāyatrī 108 times before performing the rite.
plain_english: Having chanted the gāyatrī one hundred and eight times, one should perform the rite.
